TabICL Model for tidymodels

Source: R/parsnip-tabicl.R
tab_icl.Rd

A TabICL (Tabular In-Context Learning) model that can be used with the tidymodels ecosystem (parsnip, workflows, tune, etc.) Get encoding for tab_icl model

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tab_icl'
get_encoding(object)

tab_icl(
  mode = "unknown",
  engine = "tabicl",
  n_estimators = 8,
  norm_methods = NULL,
  feat_shuffle_method = "latin",
  batch_size = 8,
  device = "auto",
  random_state = 42,
  verbose = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'tab_icl'
update(
  object,
  parameters = NULL,
  n_estimators = NULL,
  batch_size = NULL,
  device = NULL,
  random_state = NULL,
  fresh = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A model specification

mode

A single character string for the prediction mode: "classification" or "regression"

engine

A single character string specifying the computational engine. For TabICL, this is always "tabicl"

n_estimators

Number of ensemble members (integer, default: 8)

norm_methods

Normalization methods to try (default: NULL)

feat_shuffle_method

Feature permutation strategy (default: "latin")

batch_size

Batch size for ensemble processing (integer, default: 8)

device

Device to use: "auto", "cpu", or "cuda"

random_state

Random seed for reproducibility

verbose

Print detailed information during inference (default: FALSE)

...

Additional engine-specific arguments

Value

A tibble with encoding information

A model specification object

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(tidymodels)

# Regression model
tab_icl_reg_spec <- tab_icl(mode = "regression") %>%
  set_engine("tabicl") %>%
  fit(mpg ~ ., data = mtcars)

# Classification model
tab_icl_cls_spec <- tab_icl(mode = "classification") %>%
  set_engine("tabicl") %>%
  fit(Species ~ ., data = iris)
} # }
